sections.heading: Pitch Overview
sections.text: Prepared on 7 February 2026, pitch SYN-SYNCP000115-P1 was put before Redwood Care Partners 115 on behalf of Supplier.

sections.heading: Put Forward in Exchange
sections.text: In exchange the Supplier put forward a Band 1 rebate of 2 per cent.

sections.heading: Sought in Return
sections.text: The Supplier sought a yearly Hepatitis minimum take of 480 doses in return.

sections.heading: Recorded Result
sections.text: Recorded result: the Customer came back with a counter.
